source_law: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.
goal: Final-form Godot 4 coffee-house world mutation: preserve Lum idle rig, use every approved current community GLB, zoom intro camera onto Lum, add a reproducible Blender authoring bridge, and harden Nexus as a provenance-gated private donor lane.

nexus.candidate_inclusion_rule: Only material with open redistribution/conversion rights, explicit author permission, or user-owned origin may enter a distributable build.
nexus.closed_permission_rule: Closed or unknown-permission Nexus files remain private reference material and never enter GitHub, CI artifacts, or APK bundles.

blender.strategy: reproducible project generator instead of committing an opaque .blend binary
blender.animation_authority: Godot Lum AnimationTree remains runtime authority; Blender preserves imported animation data for authoring/export.
blender.ci_scope: Static Python syntax and contract audit now; Blender binary execution requires a future pinned Blender CI toolchain.

passes.name: source boundary
passes.gate: mutation isolated on candidate/final-form-coffeehouse-20260927; canonical main untouched

passes.name: scene composition
passes.gate: FinalFormWorld extends proven NeonWorld and retains thin Main orchestrator

passes.name: all current assets
passes.gate: all 77 immutable selected CC0 GLBs are instantiated and all 77 load in source/PCK smoke

passes.name: Lum rig and idle
passes.gate: existing Drive Lum socket, skin, AnimationTree and clip0/idle discovery stay authoritative

passes.name: hero camera
passes.gate: existing CutsceneBridge focuses Lum and SpringArm camera closes to 3.2 m before restore

passes.name: mobile rendering
passes.gate: GL Compatibility retained; coffee-house shell uses emissive materials and existing bounded realtime-light budget

passes.name: Nexus donor hardening
passes.gate: private provenance manifest; no wholesale vendoring, unknown-license shipping, runtime downloads, or CI leakage

passes.name: Blender bridge
passes.gate: deterministic Blender generator consumes the same manifests and all staged GLBs; script parses without importing bpy in CI

passes.name: build doctrine
passes.gate: existing exact Godot/Lum hashes, community provenance, Android export, signing/alignment and receipts remain mandatory

passes.name: exact-head proof
passes.gate: current mutation commit must pass PR-triggered exact-head community + Cathedral + rig/runtime CI before CROWN GREEN

crown_green_requires: 77 staged CC0 GLBs with provenance receipt
